title: Intern Deployment Engineer - Data & AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact — understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our team pairs deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As an intern, you will have the unique opportunity to learn and grow through hands-on experiences. Your role will involve utilizing our cutting-edge AI deployment tools to develop innovative solutions for our customers, together with more experienced Deployment Engineers.</p> <p>This is not a traditional engineering role where you build everything manually. You will be introduced to AI-augmented and business-focused software delivery: helping specify what needs to be built, learning to direct AI agents to execute, and assisting in validating the results. customer handover.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will learn to work with AI agents as your primary tools, focusing on validating and description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Allow us to introduce ourselves</strong></p> <p>Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.</p> <p>We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over <strong>260 employees</strong> spread across <strong>13 countries </strong>(we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from <strong data-stringify-type="bold">+190 markets,</strong> globally.</p> <p>Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? <strong>🚀</strong></p> <p><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Here at Appinio, we value <strong>transparency</strong> <strong>in our recruitment process</strong>, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together:</span><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><em data-stringify-type="italic">&nbsp;</em></span><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><a class="c-link c-link--focus-visible" href="https://www.appinio.com/en/blog/life-at-appinio/appinio-recruitment-process" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.appinio.com/en/blog/life-at-appinio/appinio-recruitment-process" data-sk="tooltip_parent">here</a></span></strong></p></div><div class="role"> <div class="job-ad-editable job-ad-editable job-ad-editor" data-content="6454830"> <p><strong>Your mission as an Analytics Engineer</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong data engineering skills to join our Data team and help build a scalable, reliable, and well-structured data foundation across Appinio.<br>In this role, you will design and maintain clean, scalable data models that make data easy to access, understand, and use across the organisation. You will use SQL, dbt, and Python to transform raw data into meaningful datasets, develop automated workflows, and ensure consistency and reliability across our data warehouse.<br>Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure.<br>Working closely with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and business teams, you will help define and standardise key business metrics such as revenue, bookings, and churn, ensuring a single source of truth across the company. You will also take ownership of data quality through automated testing, validation, and monitoring across the data lifecycle.<br>You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. You will also help prepare our data foundation for AI-driven analytics by ensuring that data models, business definitions, and documentation are structured, consistent, and accessible.<br>You will contribute to documentation, performance optimisation, and the continuous improvement of our data stack, helping us build a robust and scalable data platform that enables teams across Appinio to make faster, more informed decisions.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Data Modeling:</strong> Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models in the data warehouse using SQL and dbt, making data accessible and reliable for analysts and business users.</li> <li><strong>Data Transformation:</strong> Develop and maintain data transformation workflows, turning raw data from multiple sources into structured, analytics-ready datasets.</li> <li><strong>Data Pipelines &amp; Integration:</strong> Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliable data ingestion from APIs, databases, and third-party systems into the data warehouse.</li> <li><strong>Data Quality &amp; Testing:</strong> Ensure data accuracy and reliability by implementing automated tests, validations, monitoring, and proactive issue resolution across data pipelines and models.</li> <li><strong>Documentation:</strong> Document data models, pipelines, business definitions, and transformation logic to ensure transparency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing.</li> <li><strong>Business Logic Ownership:</strong> Define, implement, and standardize key business metrics (e.g. revenue, bookings, churn) to ensure consistency across reporting and analytics.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Work closely with role if</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strong SQL &amp; Data Modeling Skills:</strong> You have excellent SQL skills and hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data models in a modern data warehouse.</li> <li><strong>Experience with dbt: </strong>You have practical experience using dbt to develop, test, document, and maintain reliable data transformation workflows.</li> <li><strong>Data Engineering &amp; Python:</strong> You are proficient in Python and have experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines, including integrations with APIs, databases, and third-party systems.</li> <li><strong>Data Warehousing Knowledge: </strong>You understand modern data warehouse architectures and have experience working with cloud-based solutions such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.</li> <li><strong>Data Quality &amp; Reliability:</strong> You have a strong understanding of data quality principles, automated testing, validation, and monitoring, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.</li> <li><strong>Business Understanding:</strong> You can translate business requirements into reliable data models and title: Technisch Support Engineer
description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen. Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren? Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken. Wat ga je doen? Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische problemen Je analyseert storingen en zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, bijvoorbeeld door systeemdata en instellingen te onderzoeken. Je ondersteunt klanten telefonisch en per mail bij technische vragen en problemen. Je helpt installateurs en servicemonteurs bij het oplossen van technische problemen. Je past waar nodig instellingen van warmtepompen aan om hun prestaties te optimaliseren. Je schakelt servicemonteurs in wanneer een probleem niet op afstand kan worden opgelost en zorgt voor een goede overdracht. Je helpt onze support steeds slimmer en beter te maken Je herkent terugkerende problemen en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen. Je maakt en verbetert technische documentatie, handleidingen en werkinstructies. Je deelt inzichten uit de praktijk met onze product- en engineeringteams, zodat we onze warmtepompen verder kunnen verbeteren. Je denkt mee over hoe we onze processen en systemen kunnen verbeteren en automatiseren. Je komt terecht in een groeiend team waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Dat betekent dat je veel kunt leren, verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en zelf invloed hebt op hoe we werken. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken. Wat we belangrijk vinden: Je hebt een technische hbo-opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt technisch en analytisch inzicht en vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken hoe systemen werken. Je communiceert duidelijk en prettig, ook met mensen die minder technische kennis hebben. Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands. Je bent zelfstandig, leergierig en neemt initiatief wanneer je ziet dat iets beter kan. Je vindt het leuk om zowel met techniek als met mensen bezig te zijn. Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar. Mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste: Ervaring met technische support, troubleshooting of klantcontact. Kennis van warmtepompen, installatietechniek of andere technische systemen. Ervaring met Python, data-analyse of het automatiseren van processen. Wat bieden wij jou? Een salaris van €3.000 tot €4.000 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je ervaring. 27 vakantiedagen. Een pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding. De mogelijkheid om mee te delen in het succes van DeWarmte via onze Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR). Veel ruimte om te leren, jezelf te ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Een informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen en collega's die graag samenwerken. De mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken, naast onze gezamenlijke kantoordagen. En natuurlijk de kans om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie met producten die we zelf ontwikkelen en verbeteren. Zin om mee te bouwen? Bij DeWarmte houden we van mensen die initiatief nemen, nieuwsgierig zijn en samen dingen beter willen maken. Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. Als je graag leert, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van techniek en het helpen van mensen, maken we graag kennis met je. Compensation: €3K – €4K per month • €3K – €4K per month Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician
description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards. This is a hands-on execution role . You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager , who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). You take your daily and weekly priorities from the Assembly Tech Lead , who sets the assembly schedule and is the technical authority on the floor; fridge loading is planned in close coordination with the measurement team. What you'll be doing Core Responsibilities Assemble quantum chips into their packaging , working from technical drawings and work instructions to place and mount the chip in its housing and mount the chip in its housing with the PCB. Make the electrical connections , wirebonding (manual and automatic) will be a significant part of the daily activities, as well as manual soldering. Measure and test your work , performing the defined electrical and mechanical checks and recording the results, so issues are caught before a device moves on. Finish and close the package , including sealing, inspection, laser engraving and preparing for transportation to the measurement location. Load our cryogenic fridges with new chips to be measured , mounting packaged samples and QPUs, making the wiring, thermal and mechanical connections, and closing up the system with magnetic shields. Safeguard quality , handling fragile, high-value parts with care and following handling and ESD procedures, because a single scratch, particle or ESD event can ruin a chip. Supporting Responsibilities Flag deviations early , stopping and raising it with the Assembly Tech Lead when something does not match the instruction or does not look right, rather than improvising a fix. Help improve how we work , giving practical feedback on work instructions, fixtures and tools while our processes are still maturing. Keep a safe, clean and organised workplace , applying 5S and HSE rules every day and making sure your bench, tooling and consumables are ready. Your Profile MBO-level technical education (level 3 or 4) or equivalent, for example in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electronics, fine-mechanical or precision engineering, or lab or instrument technology. 4+ years of hands-on experience assembling mechanical, electrical or mechatronic systems; relevant internships count. Able to read work instructions with photos and technical drawings, and comfortable with basic digital tools and production systems. Good with your hands at two scales: precision in assembly, handling of fine devices and connectors, and mechanical assembly such as bolting, cabling and fitting larger parts together. Precise and patient, with a genuine liking for detailed hands-on work done well, every time, and a practical approach to solving problems. Comfortable with structured, repeatable work, and disciplined about following instructions step by step and recording what you did. Comfortable in an environment that is still being built, where not every process is finished yet and priorities can shift. A team player in a young, driven team who communicates openly and speaks up when something isn't right. Good command of technical English. Bonus if you also bring: Experience with wirebonding, die attach or other chip-packaging / microelectronics assembly. Experience with measurements, diagnostics or troubleshooting. Experience in a lab, ESD-controlled or 5S production environment. Experience assembling, servicing or setting up complex equipment, instruments or machines. Familiarity with cryogenics or vacuum systems. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. What We Offer: At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance) Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage. Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.
